title: Briefing text
text:
Day **1** briefing · handout

Fictional scenario

Briefing · Object **2026**-XJ Day **1**

Something is coming.

In this made-up story, an object is moving toward Earth. Will it hit Earth? We do not know yet. We would measure where it is at different times. Then we would use that pattern to **predict where it** will go. New facts may change our answer. This is a class story, not a NASA warning.
